observations.why: The verb 'switching' frames the move as embracing novelty — a new database — positioning change itself as the appealed-to good.
Performance gain and cost reduction appeal to achievement (winning on metrics) and mastery (capability of the system); both are named as motivating goods.
The arrow notation frames the migration as a directional move toward novelty, restating the openness-to-change appeal in summary form.
Quantifying the performance gain appeals to mastery and capability — the system's craft quality as a motivating good.
Setting a concrete timeline appeals to competence — the capability to deliver on a schedule — as the motivating frame.
